theorem WhitneyReversibility.exists_indecomposable_covering_family.{u} {X : Type u} [mX : MetricSpace X] [cX : CompactSpace X]
  {μ : WhitneyReversibility.Continuum X → Real} (hμ : WhitneyReversibility.IsWhitneyMap μ)
  (Y : WhitneyReversibility.Continuum X) (_hYnt : Set.Nontrivial (SetLike.coe (Subtype.val Y)))
  (hi : Not (WhitneyReversibility.IsDecomposable (SetLike.coe (Subtype.val Y)))) {t : Real} (ht : LT.lt 0 t)
  (htY : LT.lt t (μ Y)) :
  Exists fun S =>
    And (LE.le S (WhitneyReversibility.relativeLevel μ Y t))
      (And (IsCompact S)
        (And (IsConnected S)
          (And (Set.Nontrivial S)
            (And (Not (WhitneyReversibility.IsDecomposable S))
              (Eq (WhitneyReversibility.familyUnion S) (SetLike.coe (Subtype.val Y)))))))
